Class AetherisNotebookPanel.ExpandedSeat

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.AetherisNotebookPanel.ExpandedSeat
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
private static final class AetherisNotebookPanel.ExpandedSeat extends Object
The class ExpandedSeat is one reading of version 1 of aetheris-expanded.yaml. The record holds the checked cell ids in cells. The record holds any extra lines the parser kept in extras. blocked means the text could not be read as version 1. A version other than 1 stays unread and is not overwritten. The cell ids are not a vault column. A caller uses fresh() when the file is missing. A caller uses blocked() when the text is bad. A caller uses withCells(ArrayList) to replace the ids without dropping the extra lines.

  • Constructor Details

    • ExpandedSeat

      private ExpandedSeat(boolean blocked, ArrayList<String> cells, String extras)
      The constructor stores the blocked flag, the cell ids, and the extra lines. A null cells list is stored as a new empty list. A null extras value is stored as an empty string.
      Parameters:
      blocked - true when the file must not be overwritten
      cells - the checked cell ids, or null
      extras - the lines the parser kept, or null

    • withCells

      AetherisNotebookPanel.ExpandedSeat withCells(ArrayList<String> next)
      The method withCells copies this record with a new cell list. The copy is not blocked. The extra lines stay.
      Parameters:

      the copied record
